additional_info.subject: Description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Is it possible to check logs on the charger 170002565 on yesterday 7 of November at 8:42:22 p.m. and at 8:49:04 p.m. ?
A customer tried to charge. The recharge was accepted and when he put the plug in the car, the charger was blocked. He saw that controls were loading for some minutes, but the charge did not start.
Thank you in advance

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0460580-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002565] CU logs check CRM:00263000135
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The issue was on DC 1 both times.
Normally UTC Time is 2 hours before Italian time on our portal, but in this case we see that UTC time is only one hour before, so 8:42:22 p.m. and 8:49:04 p.m. (Italian time 9:42:22 p.m. and 9:49:04 p.m.).
Just to be sure, could be possible to check logs 2 hours before the Italian time? So, could it be possible to also check logs on November 7th, 7:42:22 p.m. and 7:49:04 p.m. ?
Thank you,
Filomena

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0460580-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002565] CU logs check CRM:00263000135
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
We would like to inform you that the charging session failure was due to an error in the SECC (Supply Equipment Communication Controller) module. The issue was resolved after a reboot of the charger. No further actions are required from the service team, and we will proceed to close the ticket.
Regarding the logs you mentioned, they were correct. However, please note that in the charger’s configuration, our DC group 2 corresponds to OCPP ID 1, and vice versa. This configuration difference was the source of the confusion.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.

201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
